show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/PFAu5a
show.description: This story follows a billionaire who believes true love is felt, not seen. After a chance meeting, he searches for a mysterious girl, unaware she is a rejected daughter with a hidden beauty and painful past. As families lie and identities clash, love challenges society’s idea of beauty and proves that real connection goes deeper than the face.
